nodes.name: .editorconfig
nodes.summary: ktlint's only configuration: 120-column limit, every disabled rule commented with its reason, Composable-scoped function-naming.

nodes.name: Dependabot
nodes.summary: Weekly grouped updates for SHA-pinned GitHub Actions.

nodes.name: CI workflow
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI. Six required checks matched by job name: Unit tests and debug build, Linting, Secret scan (gitleaks over full history), Changelog check, Room schema check, Compose IME insets. Actions pinned to full commit SHAs. Renaming a job silently blocks every PR.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Binding architecture and process rules for agents: tech stack, edition-shaped book schema, API rate/quota rules (Open Library, TMDB), coding and dependency standards, directory blueprint, test lanes and the verification command, CI required checks, versioning, release ritual, and the frozen Room schema ledger. Must be updated in the same commit as any change that invalidates it.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Keep a Changelog history; every PR touching shared/ or app/src/main must add to [Unreleased] (CI-enforced). Bundled into the app and rendered by the in-app What's new viewer; `### Internal` sections are hidden from users.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project introduction for the local-first personal media tracker (books, movies, TV).

nodes.name: ROADMAP.md
nodes.summary: The why and what of planned work, organised as numbered Tasks and Phases. Ordering and priority live on the GitHub project board instead, which wins when the two disagree.

nodes.name: :app
nodes.summary: Android application module: Jetpack Compose screens, navigation, theme, inset helpers and the MainActivity/MediaTrackerApplication entry points. Thin UI over :shared ViewModels via ViewModelFactories. Hosts the Robolectric occlusion lane and Roborazzi screenshot goldens (app/src/test) and the device-only instrumented suite (app/src/androidTest).

nodes.name: :app build
nodes.summary: Android app build: version from the catalog, Compose, Robolectric/Roborazzi test deps, seedDebugDevice task, ktlint generated-code filter, changelog asset copy.

nodes.name: app androidTest (instrumented)
nodes.summary: Device-only instrumented Compose tests run by :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest: stateless screen tests with fake callbacks, MainActivity route smoke tests (SettingsNavigationTest), and SampleDataSeedTest. Not in CI; uninstalls the app when done. The only thing that compiles this source set.

nodes.name: app main
nodes.summary: Production source of :app (package com.github.maskedkunisquat.mediatracker): entry points, export file I/O, ui/screens, ui/components, ui/navigation, ui/theme, ui/insets, ui/text, TestTags and ViewModelFactories.

nodes.name: app root package
nodes.summary: MainActivity (composition root, testTagsAsResourceId), MediaTrackerApplication (builds AppContainer, opens Room) and AppRestart.

nodes.name: app export
nodes.summary: Android file I/O for portability: CSV file reader/writer and .sqlite database file I/O via the system file picker.

nodes.name: app ui
nodes.summary: TestTags (testTag constants, never string literals) and ViewModelFactories bridging AppContainer to androidx ViewModel factories.

nodes.name: ui/components
nodes.summary: Composables shared across screens: cover image, detail header, detail progress card and status display.

nodes.name: ui/insets
nodes.summary: Window-inset padding helpers (PaddingValues arithmetic) behind the IME/safe-drawing fixes the occlusion lane guards.

nodes.name: ui/navigation
nodes.summary: AppNavigation NavHost and NavRoutes definitions; routes hand stateless screens their real callbacks.

nodes.name: ui/screens
nodes.summary: Compose screens: library, add book/movie/TV, book/movie/TV detail, edit book, settings, backup/restore, changelog, logs, about, stats. Screens larger than a file are split by user-visible region (e.g. BookDetailsTab, BookReadingHistoryTab, BookSessionDialogs). Stateless screen composables take state and emit events.

nodes.name: ui/text
nodes.summary: Numeric input filtering and book unit display formatting.

nodes.name: ui/theme
nodes.summary: MediaTrackerTheme: colour scheme, typography, dynamic colour toggle (disabled in goldens).

nodes.name: app test (Robolectric)
nodes.summary: Gated Robolectric lane run by :app:testDebugUnitTest / :app:verifyRoborazziDebug: IME occlusion geometry tests (ui/insets, Occlusion.kt), stateless screen tests, and Roborazzi screenshot goldens (ui/goldens) whose PNGs live in app/src/test/screenshots. Config pinned in robolectric.properties.

nodes.name: robolectric.properties
nodes.summary: Pins SDK, screen size and a stub Application for the Robolectric lane; the real MediaTrackerApplication opens Room in onCreate and races the test.

nodes.name: root build
nodes.summary: Root Gradle build: plugin declarations shared by both modules.

nodes.name: sample data
nodes.summary: CSV fixture library used to seed devices (seedDebugDevice) and instrumented tests (SampleDataSeedTest) through ImportDataUseCase.

nodes.name: version catalog
nodes.summary: Gradle version catalog; `[versions] app` is the single source of truth for the app version (versionCode derived as major*10000+minor*100+patch).

nodes.name: settings.gradle.kts
nodes.summary: Declares the two Gradle modules, :shared and :app.

nodes.name: :shared
nodes.summary: Kotlin Multiplatform module holding all business logic: Room KMP database, Ktor network clients (Open Library, Google Books, TMDB), content-addressed cover storage, feature use cases (books, movies, TV, portability, stats, settings) and the shared ViewModels plus AppContainer manual DI. Targets Android and JVM; the JVM target exists so the data layer can be tested against a real bundled SQLite driver.

nodes.name: :shared build
nodes.summary: KMP targets (android, jvm), Room/KSP schema export to shared/schemas, and the ktlint filter that excludes generated KSP sources by absolute path.

nodes.name: Room schemas
nodes.summary: Exported Room schema JSONs v1..v7. Every version shipped in a tag is frozen (CI-enforced); APP_DATABASE_VERSION must match the highest file.

nodes.name: shared androidMain
nodes.summary: Android actuals for :shared's expect declarations: database factory and file ops, cover/log storage directories, LogBuffer, platform logger (Logcat) and the Android AppContainer constructor.

nodes.name: shared androidUnitTest
nodes.summary: Android-host unit tests for :shared androidMain actuals (stub android.jar, no Robolectric).

nodes.name: shared commonMain
nodes.summary: Platform-independent source set of :shared (package com.hub.media): core/ (database, network, storage, util), features/ (books, changelog, media, movies, tv, portability, settings, stats) and ui/ (ViewModels, UI state, AppContainer).

nodes.name: core/database
nodes.summary: Room KMP database: AppDatabase (APP_DATABASE_VERSION=7), Migrations (loggedMigration wrapper), DatabaseFactory expect, MediaRepository, restore recovery, SQLite header sniffing and staged-database validation for .sqlite restore.

nodes.name: core/database/converters
nodes.summary: Room type converters for enums and other non-primitive column types.

nodes.name: core/database/dao
nodes.summary: Room DAOs, type-safe and Flow-based: per-table DAOs (media items, book/movie/TV details, episodes, reading sessions, external identifiers, app settings, stats) plus transactional write DAOs (BookWriteDao, MovieWriteDao, TVWriteDao, ImportWriteDao).

nodes.name: core/database/entities
nodes.summary: Room entities for the polymorphic media schema: media_items (UUID keys) with child book/movie/TV detail tables, episodes, reading_sessions, watch_logs, external_identifiers, app_settings; plus enums (MediaType, ReadingStatus, WatchStatus, BookFormat, AiringStatus, TrackingMode, IdentifierProvider).

nodes.name: core/network
nodes.summary: Ktor client factory (installs the identifying User-Agent Open Library's rate tiers depend on), RequestPacer for per-crawl rate limiting, TMDB credential, date and image-URL helpers.

nodes.name: core/storage
nodes.summary: Content-addressed cover storage (SHA-256 of raw bytes, saved as <hash>.jpg, deduplicated) and the persistent log store: LogBuffer, LogEntry codec, file log sink, per-file lock registry.

nodes.name: core/util
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting utilities: Resource/Result wrapper for network and DB calls, UUID IdGenerator, Logger facility (CompositeLogger, PlatformLogger expect), LruCache.

nodes.name: features/books
nodes.summary: Books feature: ISBN lookup (Open Library primary, Google Books fallback), title/author search, work-to-editions resolution, cover download/probe with Open Library quota limiter, bulk metadata backfill, reading sessions and the reading timer. Edition-shaped schema: work-level fields never go into edition columns.

nodes.name: books/data
nodes.summary: BookRepository and ReadingSessionRepository over the Room DAOs.

nodes.name: books/domain
nodes.summary: Book use cases: AddBookByIsbn (records edition and OPEN_LIBRARY_WORK keys), BulkBackfill, LogReadingSession, RefetchCover, ResolveWorkToEditions, plus metadata and session validation.

nodes.name: books/network
nodes.summary: Book metadata/search providers: OpenLibraryClient (edition first, authors fall back to the work), OpenLibrarySearchClient, GoogleBooksClient, FallbackBookMetadataProvider, CoverImageDownloader, OpenLibraryIsbnCoverProbe and the shared per-device OpenLibraryCoverRateLimiter quota.

nodes.name: books/network/dto
nodes.summary: kotlinx.serialization DTOs for Open Library (edition, search, work editions) and Google Books responses.

nodes.name: books/timer
nodes.summary: ReadingTimer: coroutine/Flow-based reading session timer.

nodes.name: features/changelog
nodes.summary: Parses the bundled CHANGELOG.md for the in-app What's new viewer (omitting ### Internal sections) and its inline markup.

nodes.name: features/media
nodes.summary: Type-agnostic media features shared by every medium: search across providers, delete, metadata validation rules, bulk TMDB backfill and mismatch reconciliation.

nodes.name: media/data
nodes.summary: MediaWithDetails: a media item joined with its type-specific details.

nodes.name: media/domain
nodes.summary: SearchMediaUseCase, DeleteMediaUseCase, BulkTmdbBackfillUseCase and BackfillRun, ReconcileMismatchesUseCase (acting on season/episode count mismatches), MediaMetadataValidation.

nodes.name: media/network
nodes.summary: MediaSearchProvider abstraction and MediaSearchResult model.

nodes.name: features/movies
nodes.summary: Movies: MovieRepository, metadata validation and the TMDB movie mapper.

nodes.name: movies/data
nodes.summary: MovieRepository and MovieMetadataValidation.

nodes.name: movies/domain
nodes.summary: TmdbMovieMapper: TMDB movie DTO to entities.

nodes.name: features/portability
nodes.summary: Data portability: CSV export/import (library, reading logs, episodes as its own CSV), .sqlite backup and restore, Goodreads import, duplicate policy and import summaries.

nodes.name: portability/csv
nodes.summary: CSV reader/parsing utilities, schema versioning, and exporter/importer pairs for library, reading logs and episodes.

nodes.name: portability/data
nodes.summary: ImportWriteRepository: transactional writes for imports.

nodes.name: portability/domain
nodes.summary: ExportDataUseCase, ImportDataUseCase (takes CSV strings, no file picker), DatabaseBackupUseCase, RestoreDatabaseUseCase, DuplicatePolicy, ImportSummary, CsvExportBundle.

nodes.name: portability/goodreads
nodes.summary: Goodreads export CSV importer and table reader.

nodes.name: settings/data
nodes.summary: Typed access to the app_settings key-value table: SettingsRepository, provider API keys, log verbosity, week start day, bulk/TMDB backfill state and persisted backfill mismatches.

nodes.name: stats/data
nodes.summary: StatsRepository: analytics queries and aggregate Flows.

nodes.name: features/tv
nodes.summary: TV shows: seasons/episodes progression, TMDB client and mapping, per-show episode backfill, poster fetching.

nodes.name: tv/data
nodes.summary: TVShowRepository and TVMetadataValidation.

nodes.name: tv/domain
nodes.summary: BackfillShowEpisodesUseCase (refresh a show from TMDB, reporting season findings), FetchPosterUseCase, TmdbShowMapper.

nodes.name: tv/network
nodes.summary: TmdbClient for movies and TV. AppContainer keeps the paced instance private (for crawls) and exposes the unpaced one for interactive paths; metadata and images are paced separately.

nodes.name: tv/network/dto
nodes.summary: kotlinx.serialization DTOs for TMDB responses.

nodes.name: shared ui
nodes.summary: Shared ViewModels and UI state contracts for every screen (library, add book/movie/TV, detail screens, edit, settings, backup/restore, backfill and mismatch review, changelog, logs, stats) plus AppContainer, the manual DI root. Screen behaviour belongs here so it is unit-testable off-device.

nodes.name: shared commonTest
nodes.summary: Pure-Kotlin tests that run on every :shared target. Must not touch Room: testAppDatabase() is deliberately invisible here, so a Room test in this set is a compile error.

nodes.name: shared jvmMain
nodes.summary: JVM actuals for :shared's expect declarations (database factory with bundled SQLite driver, file ops, storage dirs, logger). Exists so the data layer runs in :shared:jvmTest on the host.

nodes.name: shared jvmTest
nodes.summary: Authoritative data-layer test lane: every Room-touching test (DAOs, repositories, MigrationTest, backup/restore, most ViewModel tests) runs here against a real bundled SQLite driver. Run by :shared:jvmTest, which `./gradlew test` does NOT include.
